purpose: Canonical list of structural question presentation patterns for banking PYQ extraction into typed JSON.
usage: Use pattern.id as the question_pattern field in extraction output. Classify by packaging shape first (standalone vs set, passage vs table vs image, etc.). Content topics (syllogism, seating, series) are separate and may be layered later.

patterns.name: Standalone MCQ
patterns.description: Single question stem with options; no shared passage or directions block.

patterns.name: Shared-directions / set-based MCQ
patterns.description: One common directions/information block shared by multiple questions via direction_id.

patterns.name: Reading comprehension (passage) set
patterns.description: Long English passage in directions plus several comprehension questions on it.

patterns.name: Cloze / fill-in-the-blank passage
patterns.description: Passage with numbered blanks; each question asks which word/phrase fits a blank.
signals: Select the word that fits blank (N)
In the following passage there are blanks...

patterns.name: Image / figure / diagram based
patterns.description: Question depends on a figure, diagram, or image that must be taken from the source PDF.
patterns.notes: Extractor should retain image refs / page crops; text alone is often insufficient.

patterns.name: Visual chart / graph DI
patterns.description: Data Interpretation set based on pie/bar/line/radar or mixed charts (often image-backed in PDF).

patterns.name: Table DI set
patterns.description: Data Interpretation set based on a table of values plus several numerical questions.

patterns.name: Caselet DI set
patterns.description: Data Interpretation set based on a paragraph of quantitative information (no chart/table).
signals: Answer the questions based on the information given below

patterns.name: Data sufficiency
patterns.description: A question followed by Statement I / II (sometimes III); options indicate which statements are sufficient.
signals: two/three statements numbered I and II
which of the statements is/are sufficient

patterns.name: Quantity comparison
patterns.description: Compare Quantity I and Quantity II and choose the relationship.

patterns.name: Quadratic / two-equation comparison
patterns.description: Two equations in x and y; compare roots or relationship between x and y.

patterns.name: Match the columns / lists
patterns.description: Match Column I with Column II (or equivalent list matching) and pick the correct pairing option.

patterns.name: Partial / missing options
patterns.description: Stem is present but options are incomplete, truncated, or missing (parse/extraction gap).
patterns.notes: Keep as an explicit pattern so the pipeline can flag QA failures separately from valid formats.

patterns.name: Bilingual stem / directions
patterns.description: Same question content presented with mixed English + Hindi/Tamil (or other) text in stem and/or directions.
patterns.notes: May co-occur with another structural pattern; pipeline may store this as a flag or secondary pattern.
